lark_e06_entry.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_entry.text: Duan Zhi arrived on Day Forty One in an ordinary chair carried by two men whose accepted service ended at the lower landing. He thanked them there and paid from his already earned personal purse. Lin waited beside the association receiving keeper rather than meeting him halfway up a stair that had no room for three people to negotiate a cane. Duan stood slowly, checked the knee's response, and asked which room held his accepted lodging. His first purpose at the pass was to arrive in a body capable of tomorrow.

lark_e06_entry_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_entry_002.text: The receiving keeper brought his teaching agreement to the common room. Its eighty copper covered twenty received formal teaching meetings at four copper each, spread across the term. Travel had not been added to that category. Duan read the local cancellations and current knee limits before accepting the dated first meetings. Some instruction would be conducted seated beside a stopped board. A standing demonstration remained conditional on his present recovery and the actual task, not on the association's wish to see a competent man appear impressive to a new student.

lark_e06_entry_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_entry_003.text: Lin carried his light notebook after asking whether he wanted help. The keeper carried the heavier teaching case. Duan retained his cane and the ordinary job of choosing his next step. The arrangement felt less ceremonial than Lin's memories of first meeting a qualified teacher. He noticed her change of grip and asked whether the shoulder had been reassessed here. She gave him the current ordinary report and the task limits she had accepted. He wanted the practical result before the story of how grateful she was to be taught.

lark_e06_entry_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_entry_004.text: The association had borrowed a ground floor room for the formal meetings. Its landlord received a separate ordinary room hire from the association's operating account; the teaching fee did not quietly buy a property that nobody had offered. There was space for a low bench, a stopped contact board, and a second clear exit. Duan walked both exits with the keeper before putting his case down. A chair that allowed his knee to straighten sat at the useful side of the board. Lin moved the inkstand, leaving the clear route clear.

lark_e06_entry_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_entry_005.text: Duan did not open a lesson that afternoon. He unpacked a worn comparison strip, inspected its storage wrapper, and set it aside for Jiang Tao's apparatus check. Lin had wanted one immediate answer about the fifth pair. Instead, she learned where the checked tool would wait and when she could ask the question under the received teaching terms. The delay was not a test of obedience. Duan had travelled, and a tool had travelled. Both needed their actual conditions established before a novice put strain into a new route beside them.

lark_e06_entry_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_entry_006.text: During the following morning, the old source handoff came due. The receiving keeper laid Lin's application beside the original permitted example and the dated workshop record. Instruction here would now stand on its own locally approved curriculum. An old storm decision had determined what material Lin could actually bring to an earlier appointment; it would not grant the association indefinite custody. The keeper asked her to complete the corresponding return or closure through the source that had truly supplied it. Lin followed that record rather than writing a new version of the old watch.

lark_e06_material_gate.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_material_gate.text: The keeper checked the workshop's source line. A preserved teaching excerpt, a dated usable approach, and an actual delivered packet had supported different work. Only the source actually recorded could receive its proper closure. Older papers without that line would remain unclaimed while Lin entered the new local course through its independent ordinary requirements.

lark_e06_books_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_books_001.text: The sixteen teaching booklets protected at the old watch had stayed with their authorized keeper. Lark had received only the one permitted goat example used in Lin's applicant comparison. Lin checked the example against the workshop record and sent its keeper the agreed account of that use. The temporary working copy was returned through the licensed ordinary post, at one copper from Lin's own purse. Hu Lan kept the association's observed result without keeping a second unauthorized lesson stock. The protected booklets remained protected elsewhere, not multiplied by her new employment.

lark_e06_books_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_books_002.text: The old short approach had not reopened because the lesson example travelled successfully. Lin's closure letter named the completed workshop rather than inviting later visitors to walk a missing road. She did not reopen the courier's canceled booking, whose two copper had already been settled. The association could now design a fresh local comparison using its own authorized material. That new work would need its own source and permission. The paper she sent home brought one useful episode to an actual end, with no claim that every earlier loss had been repaired.

lark_e06_books_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_books_003.text: Qin Yi wanted to see the goat before the copy left. Lin checked the permission's ordinary reading scope and let her see the offered passage beside Shan Fang. The child decided a goat was a better example than a bell because it could refuse to be interested. Shan Fang said that was why the reading needed a clear observation heading. Qin Yi wrote one sentence in her own notebook about a goat she had seen in the market. She copied no protected passage. Lin liked that the last use of the example produced a small new question.

lark_e06_books_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_books_004.text: The keeper placed the return in the actual outgoing bag and gave Lin its ordinary dispatch receipt. By Day Fifty Four, the source keeper's acknowledgment had come back with the licensed carrier. It confirmed the example's return and the permitted workshop use. The association closed that temporary custody line. Lin could still remember what she had learned about headings, but she no longer had the borrowed teaching page to lend to a future employer. Its return was a genuine limit that memory did not cancel.

lark_e06_books_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_books_005.text: Lin filed the acknowledgment behind her application and removed the temporary lesson label from the local shelf. A example would need its own source. Shan Fang had already proposed the market's waiting corner.

lark_e06_path_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_path_001.text: The old short approach had actually survived the watch, while the sixteen booklets had been lost. Its dated route note had supported Lin's keeper led applicant walk at Lark. She sent the original route keeper an account limited to that use and retained only the local observations the workshop had authorized her to make. The ordinary post cost one copper from her own purse. A note about a road's condition on one date was not a license to promise that road's condition through winter, and her letter made no such promise.

lark_e06_path_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_path_002.text: The route keeper needed to know whether later applicants would be directed along the old approach on Lin's recommendation. They would not. The association's fresh local training used its own currently inspected paths, and Lin had no standing task to guide distant travellers. Her letter closed that potential misunderstanding before someone spent road money on it. The canceled old courier's two copper stayed a completed cancellation. The missing teaching booklets stayed missing. Lin could appreciate what the open approach had made possible without turning that usefulness into a story in which nothing had been lost.

lark_e06_path_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_path_003.text: She walked the current lower landing again with the local keeper. It was not the old distant road, and it did not have to resemble it to make the comparison useful. A basket stood too near the route notice, just as a cloth had once hidden a signal during her first observed walk. The keeper accepted an ordinary adjustment and had the basket moved by its owner. Lin wrote today's place and obstruction in the local record. Her earlier source had helped her notice the question; only today's visit answered it here.

lark_e06_path_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_path_004.text: By Day Fifty Four, the original keeper's acknowledgment reached Lark through the licensed carrier. It received the narrow route example's completed use and confirmed that no further guiding appointment had been accepted in Lin's name. The association closed the handoff line. She had not returned a road in an envelope. She had ended a temporary permission to use a dated account, leaving the actual road under its current keeper. The distinction mattered to every person who might otherwise mistake an example for a present invitation.

lark_e06_path_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_path_005.text: Lin filed the dated acknowledgment and crossed the old route example off tomorrow's source list. The local keeper offered a fresh inspection of the waiting corner instead, with its present obstruction named beside its date.

lark_e06_cart_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_cart_001.text: The protected return cart had actually delivered its old packets on their original dates, and He Xi's four copper had been received under that completed work. The teaching booklets had been lost and the short approach closed. Lin's Lark application had used the keeper permitted receiving example without private addresses. She now sent back an account of that limited comparison and requested closure of its temporary permission. The post cost one copper from her own purse. Her new employer had not purchased the old households' claims by finding their receiving dates useful.

lark_e06_cart_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_cart_002.text: Hu Lan checked the local copy before it went away. No private address had entered the association's working comparison. The observed exercise distinguished booking, departure, and receiving; it did not grant Lark authority over old claim money or the right to dispatch another packet in He Xi's name. Lin found the blank where an address would have been and felt less tempted to fill it with a helpful explanation. An omitted private fact could be exactly the thing that made an example properly usable outside the household that had supplied it.

lark_e06_cart_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_cart_003.text: The local dispatch keeper retained its own applicant result: Lin had corrected a mistaken scope before the final readback. That result belonged to what she had actually done here. The returned source retained its own completed deliveries. Neither needed to swallow the other to make a useful account. Qin asked whether the old four copper would appear in the new wages roll. Lin said it would not, because it had been paid to He Xi for different work. Qin approved a ledger that let a person's earned money stay attached to that person.

lark_e06_cart_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_cart_004.text: By Day Fifty Four, the original keeper's acknowledgment came through the licensed carrier. It received the comparison's completed use and the return of the temporary source copy. No old claim was reopened, and no later dispatch was accepted by silence. The association closed its borrowed example line. Lin could remember the difference between a booking and a receiving without continuing to hold the old packet form. The actual delivery dates had mattered, and their lesson could remain useful after a temporary paper left her hands.

lark_e06_cart_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_cart_005.text: Lin filed the completed return and left the old receiving example out of the new course folder. The dispatch keeper could offer a present local comparison later, without importing another household's finished claim.

lark_e06_service_gate.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_service_gate.text: The reference replies stood beside the source acknowledgment. Lin checked which old service had actually been received, where its remaining work belonged, and who could answer a final question. The new pass appointment did not reverse a closed room or manufacture unperformed readings. Every old reference would now finish its limited task beside the new local assessment.

lark_e06_closed_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_closed_001.text: The mountain desk's reply received the completed reference request. It described the service that had actually happened before the rainy term closed and refused to list canceled outstation dates as attendance. Ten copper had been spent under the old closeout and two returned. Those old amounts did not enter Lark's new teaching account. Lin had written her final question on Day Forty Four and paid the ordinary one copper postage herself. The reply now gave her a precise answer she could place beside the local applicant result.

lark_e06_closed_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_closed_002.text: The desk's delayed contact had cost Lin an earlier chance to speak with a travelling household reader. That reader had already gone home. The reply did not offer to summon the person again at someone else's expense. It enclosed one permitted written reference instead. Lin read it with Hu Lan and accepted its limits. A written account could answer the new employer's question about past receiving. It could not give her the conversation, local introduction, or lost meeting date that her old closure had made unavailable.

lark_e06_closed_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_closed_003.text: Qin had asked whether she still belonged to an outstation because people had heard she once kept reading hours. She showed him the public closeout sentence, which named no private reader. The old rainy term had ended. He could now invite her to a present household gathering without reserving an imaginary afternoon for a room that no longer opened. The loss had become less dramatic with time, but it had not become false. Somewhere below the mountains, people who wanted that old service had found other ordinary arrangements.

lark_e06_closed_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_closed_004.text: The association received the desk's reference and closed its inquiry. It accepted Lin for the local course through the current prerequisite assessment, not as a substitute for the vanished old post. She put the reply away and told the lodging keeper her new instruction dates. Her present hours would be negotiated here among people who could actually attend them. The old outstation remained closed through the rainy term. It would take a fresh offered and accepted arrangement to become something else, and nobody at this table pretended to have made one.

lark_e06_reserved_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_reserved_001.text: The old keeper's reply named the one inspected reading that had actually occurred under the reserved service. Twelve copper had been used for its accepted scope; later rainy term dates had been canceled after the inspected room lost approval. Lin's last reference question had been posted on Day Forty Four at her own one copper cost. The reply received that question without upgrading one completed meeting into an uninterrupted season. Hu Lan compared the date with the earlier reference and found the narrow account consistent.

lark_e06_reserved_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_reserved_002.text: The keeper enclosed a permitted reader's note about that single meeting. It described how a difficult passage had been read twice and how the final offered explanation had been accepted. Lin remembered the actual afternoon behind it and regretted the readings that had not followed. They could have made a useful relationship with the reader. The note did not claim such a relationship already existed. It gave Lark an example with one date, one receiving, and a future the room's later closure had cut short.

lark_e06_reserved_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_reserved_003.text: Qin wanted to know whether she could still borrow the reserved room if the shrine's mending gathering needed more space. Lin could not promise it. Its later dates had been canceled, and the one completed inspection did not approve it indefinitely. She offered the keeper's public status line rather than a cheerful guess. Qin said the shrine room would do if people stopped storing half their households beneath its stools. His small complaint gave the lost outstation a current consequence: the local gathering would need to solve its own actual space.

lark_e06_reserved_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_reserved_004.text: The association received the single reading reference and finished its inquiry. Lin's local teaching appointment now rested on new terms and the current pass assessment, not on an imaginary continuous post elsewhere. She folded the reader's permitted note into the old file. It still held a voice she was glad to have met once. The canceled later dates remained outside her account of what she had done. There was room in the new term for another relationship, but it would begin with people who could actually sit at the next table.

lark_e06_transferred_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_transferred_001.text: The school keeper's reply received Lin's final reference question, posted on Day Forty Four at her own one copper expense. It named the old transport and three introductory sessions funded by the twelve copper transfer, then the school's separately accepted ordinary hours. The annex remained closed. The school did not owe Lark its whole reading register merely because Lin had once helped there. Its permitted reference described her completed contribution and the receiving that ended her particular appointment before the road journey.

lark_e06_transferred_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_transferred_002.text: One introductory reader had continued at the school, under a different keeper's accepted ordinary schedule. The news pleased Lin without adding that later attendance to her own work. It was an actual benefit of the transfer and an actual limit on her part in it. She had not brought the school uphill with her. The reply's public paragraph could be read to the association; a separate household passage remained private. Hu Lan accepted the offered reference without asking Lin to improve its usefulness by opening the folded section.

lark_e06_transferred_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_transferred_003.text: Shan Fang was interested in the school's practical arrangement for reading between paid work hours. Lin could share the public schedule method, not the households' names or the school keeper's authority. They compared the method with the shrine room's current gathering, which had different space and different teachers. The school transfer had made a usable public example available. It did not supply a mountain teacher, new twelve copper purse, or approved annex. Shan Fang chose one scheduling question to ask her own neighbors rather than importing a whole institution from a letter.

lark_e06_transferred_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_transferred_004.text: The association received the school's bounded reference and closed its old inquiry. Lin put the private household passage into her own file without making it a lesson source. The school retained its current accepted service under its own keeper, and the old annex stayed closed. Local instruction would now proceed through Duan's actual appointment and the new practice room's received conditions. Lin could welcome news from a place she had helped while letting it continue to belong to the people who remained there.

lark_e06_access_gate.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_access_gate.text: Hu Lan then received the record of Lin's two chosen afternoons. A restricted report, a public posting, and a grain room meeting had different recipients. Lin would close the work she had actually accepted before spending the next term's practice hours. The keeper retained only the corresponding record; a missing older invitation supplied no confidential access or invented attendance.

lark_e06_restricted_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_restricted_001.text: Lin sat beside Hu Lan while the board received her restricted comparison report on Day Fifty Four. The sample numbers remained separate. The repeated hole measurement, the altered warning position, and the cleaning tool requirement each had their actual method beside them. A board member wanted the shorter conclusion that the new design was better. Lin would not sign it without the tasks and conditions that made each comparison true. The board accepted her bounded report instead and entered the supplier's unresolved service proposal as a separate matter.

lark_e06_restricted_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_restricted_002.text: Chen's client received its own permitted measurement and the public decision. It did not receive the association's licensed internal geometry through Lin's report. Hu Lan kept the room notebook in the agreed cupboard and signed the completion of Lin's recorder role. The two afternoons and report had now been performed. Lin had no continuing free duty to answer every supplier question that followed. A future detailed observation would need a new appointment, and the private appendix would still need its actual keeper's permission.

lark_e06_restricted_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_restricted_003.text: Chen met her afterward in the common room. He had hoped the report would make the service proposal easier to discuss, and it had, although it did not produce a sale. His client now knew which tool requirement it had to price. He thanked Lin for refusing the board's broad conclusion before the client could repeat it as a claim. She could remember the internal clearance question, but she could not publish its dimensions to make their friendship profitable. They ate a late ordinary meal and talked about things other than fittings.

lark_e06_restricted_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_restricted_004.text: The board's receiving completed the local access obligation. Lin left her practice notebook in its cupboard and took only the public completion acknowledgment away. If another person asked whether she had been in the confidential room, she could say yes and name the offered recorder's scope. If asked for its geometry, she would need to direct the question back to Hu Lan. Restricted knowledge had made her work more detailed and her later answers more bounded. She entered the new course with that experience, not with a private archive she could carry off.

lark_e06_public_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_public_001.text: Hu Lan received the board keeper's acknowledgment of Lin's public jig sheet on Day Fifty Four. The posted result named the bench sample and instructed readers to report a changed warning through the actual keeper. It did not diagnose an installed housing from a red mark alone. A board member wanted to add that the new design was better. Lin asked where the public jig had tested the hidden conditions needed for that claim. It had not. The offered sheet stayed within the ordinary observations the session had actually produced.

lark_e06_public_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_public_002.text: The onion seller had already used her permitted copy when a neighbor claimed the new fitting stood in the bell room. She pointed to the sample's bench location and the public decision that no installation had yet been accepted. That correction did not stop every rumor in the market. It stopped one person from walking to an uninstalled object with a complaint about its paint. Lin found the limited success satisfying. A public comparison could change a real action without becoming a complete answer to every technical question.

lark_e06_public_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_public_003.text: Chen's client received the authorized public observations and the association's next proposal. Any restricted comparison remained for separately appointed qualified people; Lin's session had not supplied its missing dimensions. Chen asked whether she regretted leaving that question unanswered. She said she regretted not having every afternoon in the month, which was a different matter. The public readers had used the work she chose. The hidden geometry remained hidden from her. He accepted that she had not been waiting to reverse her choice after seeing which conclusion would sound most impressive.

lark_e06_public_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_public_004.text: Hu Lan closed the public session role with its actual posting received. Lin kept the copy she was authorized to use and gave Shan Fang its current public status date. Future readings could explain that sheet while its conditions remained current. They could not promise the market's eventual fitting decision. Lin entered Duan's course with one practical lesson about readers, a usable permitted drawing, and no confidential appendix access. Each of those facts had come from the two afternoons she chose, and none required the other choices to have happened secretly.

lark_e06_grain_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_grain_001.text: The grain organizer sent a receiving note to Hu Lan on Day Fifty Four. It confirmed Lin's two unpaid afternoons, the revised present inspection arrangement, and the roof repair she had helped record. It did not claim the older grain liability had been settled. One damaged sack still carried a disputed history. The organizer had sold its salvage under a clearly different description rather than make a later buyer inherit the argument. Lin read the note with relief that her helpful visit had not been inflated into an independent judgment she had never agreed to give.

lark_e06_grain_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_grain_002.text: The next ordinary grain delivery had been inspected at receiving by the carrier and room keeper together. Its count and present condition were both entered this time. A small seam tear was found before stacking and marked on the actual sack. Nobody called the finding an insult to the carrier. The carrier could say it had been there at handoff instead of arguing about it a month later. Lin had not attended this later delivery; the organizer's received account was her source. The practical arrangement had begun working without her continuous presence.

lark_e06_grain_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_grain_003.text: Chen's client had received the association crew's restricted comparison decision through its authorized channel. Lin knew the public postponement but not the hidden dimensions. Chen did not offer those dimensions over supper as a reward for the fact that she had missed the meeting. He told her his client was pricing a revised tool requirement and might make a later proposal. She told him about the torn grain seam and the receiving book that finally had a place to name it. Both businesses had become more specific without becoming simpler.

lark_e06_grain_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_grain_004.text: Hu Lan closed Lin's declined comparison invitation beside the grain organizer's completed record. No confidential duty waited for her, and no appendix access had been earned by working in another room. The grain sellers knew they could invite her again, but a future invitation would still need her answer. She entered Duan's course with a repaired roof in someone else's custody, a clearer present receiving method, and an unresolved old loss she had not concealed. Choosing ordinary neighbors had made one useful afternoon unavailable to the supplier, and the useful work had justified that real cost.

lark_e06_course_001.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_001.text: On Day Fifty Four, the new course register lay open on the low bench. Before any powered practice, the association had documented Duan's authority to teach this local primary pair method. His recovered six pair competence and beginner examining work were the source, with the knee's present limits beside them. The register did not award him a higher realm. Jiang Tao's apparatus authority sat in another column. His qualification concerned the stopped board, independent checks, and ordinary operating conditions. Nobody inferred his personal cultivation stage from the fact that his measurements were trusted.

lark_e06_course_002.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_002.text: Su Yan's accepted examination appointment had arrived on Day Forty Five. Her existing ninth stage furnace examining competence supported the separate local six pair examination scope that the board now approved in writing. She would finish her current furnace obligations before travelling for Days One Hundred Fifty through One Hundred Seventy One. The agreed thirty two copper covered that actual visit's room and road scope. She had not taught Lin's new course, and she would not be physically present before the appointment. A remote acceptance was permission to prepare, not an invisible expert beside today's board.

lark_e06_course_003.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_003.text: The local examination method had been registered before Lin's first attempt. Three trials would need six distinct primary pairs under stopped grounded tasks, changed task order, and independent witnessing. Each would be followed by a normal next day check after sampling, ordinary activity, and sleep. The recovered usable reserve would need to meet forty eight units with compatibility at least ninety percent under the agreed measurement. A failed or interrupted attempt would require stopping and renewed recovery; an attractive number taken immediately after exertion would not replace those checks.

lark_e06_course_004.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_004.text: Duan asked Lin to read the primary route boundary back to him. Her new pair would remain in the primary trunk system. There was no offered middle or upper dantian, no liquid reserve, and no extraordinary vessel hidden in the phrase six pairs. He was not teaching flight, sword aura, or tissue healing. Lin could repeat the words readily. The harder part would be remembering them when a familiar task appeared easy and the mountain supplied a reason to ask for more. Duan said they would practice the stopping condition as deliberately as the start.

lark_e06_course_005.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_005.text: The contact board had received Jiang's current apparatus check. Its task was supported at ground height, isolated from the freight bell and every load on the gallery. The small practice fuel purchase came from the allocated practice portion, with its copper price recorded as a purchase rather than a quantity of Lin's own qi. No shared signal stone would become her personal reserve. Duan showed the ordinary disconnect and had her operate it with an unpowered hand before agreeing to proceed. Her shoulder stayed in the low position the clinician had accepted.

lark_e06_course_006.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_006.text: His first received teaching meeting used Lin's established four primary pairs. The task began at a small registered input and stopped within the old application ceiling: half the input across four breaths, with a quarter useful yield and no breath carrying more than an eighth of the input. Today was a current observation of that task, not an enlargement of its duration or reach. Duan sat beside her where he could see the board. Jiang watched the apparatus independently. Lin had room to withdraw her hand without crossing somebody else's arm.

lark_e06_course_007.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_007.text: The familiar fourth pair felt less certain under a changed ordinary task order. Lin wanted to complete the last movement quickly before anyone noticed. Duan asked her to name the stopping condition. Naming it made the haste visible to herself. She stopped before extending the movement beyond the received task. The board's ordinary strip returned to its resting mark. Nothing had fallen, and no fifth pair had appeared. She had performed the part of instruction least likely to look impressive from outside: refusing to make an uncertain continuation merely because the first movements had worked.

lark_e06_course_008.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_008.text: After the agreed rest, the current baseline was received under the registered method. Her four pair reserve remained within the fifth stage prerequisite, with at least thirty six usable units and compatibility meeting ninety percent in the recovered check. The report did not say the fifth pair had opened. It did not convert the ordinary shoulder assessment into permission for overhead work. Duan received this first formal meeting's four copper teaching fee, leaving nineteen meetings and seventy six copper in its accepted scope. Lin carried a question about haste out of the room instead of a new certificate.

lark_e06_course_009.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_009.text: The practice plan separated supervised meetings from her own ordinary recovery days. She would begin the slow fifth pair work on Day Fifty Five, inside the newly received local limits. There was no promise that an open sensation would count as a stable route, and no appointment for using it on a freight load. Duan asked her to tell the lodging keeper which mornings would require a quieter meal rather than arriving hungry after a crowded stair. The instruction had reached the mundane point where a bowl and a bedtime could affect a test more than ambition did.

lark_e06_course_010.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_010.text: Between Days Forty Three and Fifty Two, Lin had completed four more accepted ordinary shifts under the posted safe role. Their receiving records brought her paid total to forty copper for ten shifts, leaving thirty five possible shifts and one hundred forty copper in that wages category. Her two additional received lodging weeks brought the provision to twenty copper, with twenty weeks still ahead. She had not worked at the board and called it a freight shift. The dates made space for both kinds of work by showing which one had actually occupied each day.

lark_e06_course_011.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_011.text: The shrine room's new shelf had arrived while the old letters travelled. Its carpenter received the neighbors' separately agreed price after fitting it to the accepted height. Qin's first test was whether his daughter's paper animal could stand on it without blocking a basket. The answer was no, because Qin Yi had enlarged the animal again. Shan Fang assigned it a window corner instead. The room now held four people mending sleeves while a fifth waited for a stool. The shelf had solved a real storage problem and left the equally real shortage of seats.

lark_e06_course_012.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_012.text: Lin joined them after the assessment. Her own glove had developed a hole at the thumb, which gave her a sufficient reason to enter without being useful to anybody else. Shan Fang showed her how to place a patch so the new seam would not rub the same spot. Lin made the first stitches too tight. She undid them slowly while Qin Yi counted each retreat as a defeat. The child lost interest when Lin kept unpicking without surrendering the glove. This was a skill whose correction could be seen by anyone willing to watch thread.

lark_e06_course_013.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_013.text: Qin returned from a freight receiving with a small fish wrapped in a leaf. The recipient had offered it as an ordinary gift after the paid delivery was closed, not as a substitute for his wages. He asked the household whether anybody wanted it before making a proud story of acquiring supper. Qin Yi preferred beans. Shan Fang wanted the fish but declined to spend the last of the evening cleaning it. Qin took the knife downstairs and did the work himself. Lin kept sewing, relieved that no guest was asked to convert gratitude into a household duty.

lark_e06_course_014.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_014.text: Later, Duan came to the shrine room's doorway with his cane. He had asked where a visitor could sit without walking another steep stair, and the lodging keeper directed him there. Shan Fang invited him to the stool whose seat had been repaired. He tested it with ordinary pressure and sat. Qin Yi wanted a story about a cultivator who could fly. Duan offered one about a cultivator who bought a badly measured shoe. She accused him of misusing his qualifications. He said the shoe had also failed to respect them.

lark_e06_course_015.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_015.text: The story had happened to him. He had chosen a handsome shoe without walking in it, then carried it home in his hand after the fourth landing. Qin Yi listened more closely once a real grown man was at fault. Duan admitted that the shoemaker had offered a walking trial and he had declined it because another customer was waiting. The child decided the handsome shoe should have been required to wait instead. Shan Fang laughed hard enough to lose the needle's eye. Lin thought an examiner's authority could survive being accompanied by an ordinary bad purchase.

lark_e06_course_016.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_016.text: Nobody asked Duan to demonstrate a sixth pair in the mending room. He was a tired visitor in a repaired chair, telling a child a shoe story while other people worked. Lin liked him more in that position than she would have liked an unasked spectacle. When he left, Qin opened the clear route and walked beside him only as far as the landing he chose. The room resumed its smaller noises. An ordinary qualified person had passed through without being made responsible for every difficulty that happened to share the room.

lark_e06_course_017.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_017.text: Shan Fang's sister had replied to the employment question. She could afford four visiting days without wages if the return fare stayed untouched. The lower stall owner offered no present job. Shan Fang accepted the four days as a family visit instead of persuading her sister to call it employment. Lin watched her write the answer with an excitement the absence of work had not erased. The sisters would have tea in the cleared room. A plan had become smaller and more possible, which did not make its happiness small.

lark_e06_course_018.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_018.text: At her lodging, Lin filed the last old acknowledgments behind the closed application. Whatever sources and services had brought her to this pass, their actual completed uses were now received. None remained a secret treasury or a command over distant keepers. The local teaching appointment and its present checked board could carry the next work. She took the practice plan to the window and read the morning's stopping condition once more. Across the market, the bell sounded for the ordinary freight crew. She was not on that shift and let it belong to them.

lark_e06_course_019.speaker: narrator
lark_e06_course_019.text: Tomorrow she would attempt a slow task that no promise could complete in advance. Lin set the low stool where the shoulder would not be forced high, then moved it back so the doorway stayed clear. The two positions could not be solved by having more qi. She folded her mended glove beside the clinician's cloth roll and left the course plan open to its first practice day. Sleep came later than she wanted, but it came without a new route hidden in the dark. The fifth pair would need morning, witnesses, and work.
